name: Calendar page
author: WinDock
description: Today's date as a skeuomorphic calendar page: a coloured header with the month (or weekday) over a big day number, as a flip calendar or a flat page. Turns over at midnight of its time zone (one timer, nothing in between).

settings.label: Style
settings.description: A flip calendar (stacked pages that turn over at midnight) or a plain flat page. Default: flip calendar.

choices.label: Flip calendar (split page, stacked pages, page curl)

settings.label: Show the month in the header
settings.description: Writes the month in the coloured header; when off, the weekday goes there instead. On by default.

settings.label: Show the weekday
settings.description: In the header when the month is off, else under the day.

settings.label: Show the year
settings.description: Adds the year under the day number. Off by default.

settings.label: Header colour
settings.description: The colour of the page's header. Default: red.

settings.label: Clicking the page opens
settings.description: What a click on the page does: open the month calendar, open the app or URL below, or nothing. Default: the month calendar.

settings.label: App or URL
settings.description: Opened by a click when "Clicking the page opens" is the app or URL (needs the widget's shell permission).

settings.label: Size in DIPs (0: the dock's icon size)
settings.description: How big the page is drawn on a dock; 0 uses the dock's icon size. Default: 0.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.description: Today's date in the local time, or in any Windows time zone (the page turns over at that zone's midnight).
